title: docs(deployment): name the npm 10 `edgesOut` install failure and its npm 11 / overrides.vitest remedies
body:
Fixes #23849

Clause-②: no

Docs only. npm 10, the npm that Node 22 ships, cannot install `@objectstack/cli` or `@objectstack/plugin-auth` today. This PR names the failure where npm readers meet it and gives the two measured remedies: npm 11, or a root `overrides.vitest`. A global install can only use the first.

## Upstream, re-measured at claim (2026-10-16T09:13Z)

- `npm view vitest dist-tags` gives `V4: 4.1.12` and `latest: 5.0.5`.
- `npm view @vitest/browser-webdriverio versions --json` shows the 4.x line ending at `4.1.11`. There is no `4.1.12`.
- `vitest@4.1.12` has an optional peer `@vitest/browser-webdriverio: ^4.1.11`, and `@vitest/browser-webdriverio@4.1.11` peers `vitest: 4.1.11` exactly.
- `better-auth@1.7.3` has an optional peer `vitest: ^2.0.0 || ^3.0.0 || ^4.0.0`. `@objectstack/plugin-auth@next` (18.0.0-next.2) still pins `better-auth: 1.7.3`.
- Verdict: no coherent vitest 4 peer set has shipped, so the target does not shrink.

## Reproduction and remedies

Each case ran in a fresh empty directory with a fresh `--cache`. Exit codes were captured before any pipe, and every tree was deleted afterwards. On the host: Node 22.22.0 with npm 10.9.4. In the container: `node:22-slim` at `sha256:c3de60bf2f9dd0ac6370e6117950ff62d6e339527e7472301c9c78a017978392` (Node 22.23.3, npm 10.9.9).

| case | npm | command | exit | `edgesOut` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 10.9.4 | `npm install @objectstack/plugin-auth@next` | 1 | yes |
| B | 10.9.4 | `npm install -g @objectstack/cli@next` | 1 | yes |
| F | 10.9.4 | `npm install -g @objectstack/cli@17.7.0` (the page's pin) | 1 | yes |
| K | 10.9.4 | `npm create objectstack@latest my-app`, no pnpm on PATH | 0, but its install step failed | yes |
| docker, current recipe | 10.9.9 | the page's self-built recipe at `1eac7ad75`, as written | 1 | yes |
| C | 11.21.0 | `npm install @objectstack/plugin-auth@next` | 0 | no |
| D | 11.21.0 | `npm install -g @objectstack/cli@next` | 0 | no |
| G | 11.21.0 | `npm install -g @objectstack/cli@17.7.0` | 0 | no |
| I | 11.19.1 (Node 24's npm) | `npm install -g @objectstack/cli@next` | 0 | no |
| J | 12.2.0 | `npm install -g @objectstack/cli@next` | 0 (warns that npm 12 does not support Node 22.22.0) | no |
| O | 11.21.0 | `npm create objectstack@latest my-app` | 0, install ran | no |
| N | 10.9.4, then 11.21.0 | scaffold on npm 10 (its install fails), then `npm install` on npm 11 in that project | 0 | no |
| E | 10.9.4 with a root override `vitest: ~4.0.0` | `npm install @objectstack/plugin-auth@next` | 0 | no |
| E2 | 10.9.4 with the same override | `npm install @objectstack/cli@next` | 0 | no |
| H | 10.9.4 with the same override in the cwd | `npm install -g @objectstack/cli@next` | 1 | yes: `-g` reads no overrides |
| L | lockfile from 11.21.0, then `npm ci` on 10.9.4 | `@objectstack/cli` 17.7.0 as a devDependency, no override | 0 | no |
| M | pnpm 10.28.0 | `pnpm add @objectstack/plugin-auth@next` | 0 | no |
| docker, new recipe | 10.9.9 image npm, install under 11.21.0 | the new recipe at `dc2370288`, as written | 0 | no |

Both published scaffolders ship a blank template with no `overrides`: `create-objectstack@17.7.0` (`latest`) and `@18.0.0-next.2` (`next`). The template fix from #23799 is on `main` but not released yet, which is why case K fails.

Checks on the new-recipe image, run with `docker run`:
- `os --version` prints `@objectstack/cli/17.7.0`.
- The image's own npm is still 10.9.9.
- `/tmp/os-installer-npm` is gone.
- `pg` and `mysql2` resolve from driver-sql's directory.
- No `vitest` is installed.
- The image is 1.14 GB.

The boot is NOT MEASURED. The build context carried a placeholder artifact, and the only line this PR changes is the install `RUN`.

How the Docker builds ran: a private `dockerd` in this container, behind its agent proxy. The base was `node:22-slim` at the digest above, with the proxy CA added through `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` and re-tagged locally. The builds used `--network host` and took the proxy as build args. Each recipe was extracted byte-for-byte from the committed page, not retyped.

## Pages changed

- `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`
  - **Self-built runtime recipe.** It now installs under a pinned npm 11: npm is fetched into `/tmp`, put first on PATH for that `RUN`, and deleted in the same layer. This is the shape `docker/Dockerfile` has used since #23799.
  - The install line also takes `docker/Dockerfile`'s `"pg@^8.0.0" "mysql2@^3.0.0"`. The page presents this recipe as what "the official image is nothing more than", and without the drivers that is not true. Both drivers are optional peers of `@objectstack/driver-sql@17.7.0`, which npm does not install, and the new image's CLI tree carries no `pg` of its own.
  - The `@objectstack/cli@17.7.0` literal stays, so `check:docs-image-tag` still reads it.
  - **Bare Node.js host install.** One sentence names the failure, and `npm install -g npm@11` now comes before the CLI install. npm 11 needs Node 22.9 or newer (the `engines` of `npm@11.21.1`). The text says `npm@11` and not `npm@latest`, because `npm@latest` is 12.2.0, which warns on Node 22.22.0.
- `content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx`: a new "Installation Issues" section with one entry, headed by the error text (anchor `#cannot-read-properties-of-null-reading-edgesout-from-npm-install`). It gives the symptom, a one-line cause, both fixes, and when the entry and the notes that link to it can be removed.
- `content/docs/getting-started/index.mdx` and `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`: one warn Callout at each Prerequisites table. Both pages tell an npm user to scaffold, and the published scaffolder's install step fails on npm 10 (case K). `build-with-claude-code.mdx` links to the first one for its prerequisites.

This PR leaves the `dockerfile title="Dockerfile"` block alone. That is the scaffold's build stage: `dockerfile-build-stage.test.ts` pins it to the template, and its `npm ci` from a lockfile is not affected (case L).

## Pages grepped and left alone

I ran `git grep` over `content/docs/**`, excluding `releases/**` and `references/**`. It searched for `npm install`, `npm i`, `npm ci`, `npm install -g`, `npm create objectstack`, `npx create-objectstack`, and `pnpm add` or `yarn add` of the CLI or plugin-auth. These matches stay as they are:

- `getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx:51` (`npm create objectstack@latest`). Its prerequisites link to `getting-started#prerequisites`, which now carries the note.
- `getting-started/index.mdx:186`: `npm install -g pnpm`, not the CLI.
- `deployment/install-modes.mdx`: no npm install of the CLI or plugin-auth, only `os package install`.
- `deployment/cli.mdx:14` (`pnpm add -D @objectstack/cli`), `permissions/authentication.mdx:98` and `plugins/index.mdx:196` (`pnpm add @objectstack/plugin-auth`): these use pnpm, which passes (case M).
- `deployment/cli.mdx:26,100`, `capabilities/index.mdx:30` and `ai/skills-reference.mdx:36` (`npm create objectstack@latest`): outside this claim's file surface, so not edited. Readers there can find the troubleshooting entry by the error text. They are named in the Acceptance notes.
- `npm install` of other packages (`@objectstack/driver-turso`, `@objectstack/skills`, `@objectstack/core`, `pg`, `mysql2`): plugin-auth is not in their trees.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md` (comment 6211828218): a Tier H file, not in this claim, and left with triage.

## Gates (local, at `7f4e1158e`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 41 commands. All 41 ran and all exited 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reports 41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN.
  - Two gates first refused with exit 3 (prerequisite not met) and passed once their inputs were built. `check:docs-transcript-drift` needed `@objectstack/lint...` built. `@objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` needed `@objectstack/client-react...` built.
- `check:docs-image-tag` exits 0.
- Tests that read these pages:
  - `create-objectstack`: `src/dockerfile-build-stage.test.ts`, 5 of 5 pass.
  - `@objectstack/cli`: the doc-floor cases of `test/scaffold-emission-policy.e2e.test.ts` (a nightly-tier file), 2 pass. The TypeScript floors it reads (`5.3+` and `5.3.0 or later`) are unchanged.
- An MDX compile of the four pages with the docs app's `@mdx-js/mdx` and `remark-gfm` passes for all four. The control, one page with its closing Callout tags removed, fails.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-23849-npm10-install-docs` reports the PR as not governed, with 54 changed lines.
- The `Build Docs` job and the rest of CI are read from this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- When the dependency install fails, the published `create-objectstack` prints "Run `npm install` manually.", but its "Next steps" list leaves `npm install` out. It prints that step only under `--skip-install` (the `options.skipInstall` branch of the next-steps block in `packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts`). Measured on 17.7.0 in case K. Reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- `deployment/cli.mdx`, `capabilities/index.mdx` and `ai/skills-reference.mdx` also tell npm readers to scaffold, but they are outside this claim's surface.
- The troubleshooting entry states its own removal condition and lists the notes that go with it.
